intent.statement: Build session issuance and revocation for an API gateway with a verification latency budget.
intent.normalized: session service: issuance, revocation, verification latency budget

glossary.definition: A bearer credential issued to one user with a sliding expiry.
The in-process set of revoked token identifiers refreshed from the repository.

assumptions.statement: Tokens are bearer credentials; mutual TLS is out of scope for v1.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Verification would need a transport-level identity check before token validation.

requirements.statement: The system shall issue a **Session** token with a one-hour sliding expiry.
The system shall reject a revoked token on the next request.
NFR: token verification must complete within 50 ms at p95.

decisions.decision: Use short-lived signed tokens instead of server-side session rows.
decisions.rationale: Stateless verification keeps the hot path off the database; revocation covers the compromise case.

alternatives.rejected_because: Every request would cost a database round trip.

decisions.decision: Serve revocations from an in-process denylist refreshed from the repository.
decisions.rationale: The refresh interval dominates the revocation window and stays well inside the latency budget.

contracts.definition: export function issueToken(userId: string, ttlSeconds: number): SessionToken

tasks.title: Token issuance
tasks.purpose: Issue signed session tokens with a sliding expiry.
preconditions: Signing key provisioned in the test environment
invariants: Issued tokens always carry a one-hour sliding expiry
tasks.instructions: Implement token signing and the sliding-expiry refresh inside src/auth.

cases: REQ-0001: an issued token carries a one-hour sliding expiry

acceptance: Issued tokens verify and slide their expiry

tasks.title: Revocation path
tasks.purpose: Reject revoked tokens on the next request within the verification budget.
invariants: A revoked token is never accepted, even once
tasks.instructions: Implement the denylist refresh and the verification fast path inside src/session.

cases: REQ-0002: revoked sessions are rejected on the next request
OPS-0001: the revocation check stays within the 50 ms p95 budget

acceptance: Revoked tokens fail verification inside the budget
